method: Each PDF URL was read directly from the live official publisher archive DOM, then downloaded through that exact archive link. All 63 downloaded files have PDF headers and SHA-256 digests equal to their corresponding catalogue source digest. No PDF filenames or URL upload-date directories were guessed. Issue title/date are the converted source catalogue's reviewed metadata; exact publisher link labels are preserved.
